from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyBasicEPS(BaseModel):
    """The basic earnings per share reported by one company in a financial report."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The company name as reported")
    stock_code: str | None = Field(description="The stock/security code for the company")
    basic_eps: float | None = Field(description="Basic earnings per share value; negative if a loss")
    unit: str | None = Field(description="Currency and share unit, e.g. '元/股'")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period, e.g. '2024年第一季度'")
    quote: str = Field(description="A short verbatim excerpt anchoring the EPS value")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_basic_eps_list: list[CompanyBasicEPS]
